column1: # release-invariants.tsv — claim-preservation invariants checked at every HEAD.
# release  the release that registered the invariant (v15, v16, ...). The
#          current major must have at least one row, so a release cannot ship
#          without declaring what it must keep saying and must not say.
# kind     require = literal substring that MUST appear in the concatenated scope
#          forbid  = regular expression (case-insensitive) that must NOT match
# scope    comma-separated repo-relative files, concatenated before matching
# note     why the invariant exists; shown in the failure message
# These are tripwires, not semantic proofs. `require` catches deletion of a
# stated classification; `forbid` catches a known overclaim phrasing. Neither
# detects prose that keeps a token while negating it, or an overclaim worded
# around the pattern. Prefer several narrow rows over one clever regex.
# Adding a release never requires editing check-release-qualification.py.
# A row whose scope file is absent is an error, not a silent skip.
